say:1:1041548301:1.text: Merlin's "Compendium of Practical Magic" really does contain 777 spells! Isn't that just proof of why Magister Merlin is the greatest mage to ever live?
say:1:1041548301:1.source_cn: 梅林的著作《实用魔法集录》里居然真的介绍了777种实用...
say:1:1041548301:1.male: Merlin's "Compendium of Practical Magic" really does contain 777 spells! Isn't that just proof of why Magister Merlin is the greatest mage to ever live?
say:1:1041548301:1.female: Merlin's "Compendium of Practical Magic" really does contain 777 spells! Isn't that just proof of why Magister Merlin is the greatest mage to ever live?

say:2:1041548302:1.text: Diligent child, may I see the book you're clutching so tightly?
say:2:1041548302:1.source_cn: 用功的孩子，你手上的书可以借我看一下吗？

say:4:1041548304:1.text: Practical Magic... Hmm, this takes me back. An old publication indeed.
say:4:1041548304:1.source_cn: 哦，实用魔法……这是好多年前的出版物了。

say:5:1041548305:1.text: But even after all these years, the knowledge within remains invaluable!
say:5:1041548305:1.source_cn: 多年前的书籍到现在，依旧这么有借鉴意义呢。

say:6:1041548306:1.text: Invaluable? Tell me, who still uses those ancient restoration spells to fix crumbling statues?
say:6:1041548306:1.source_cn: 借鉴意义？现在还有人会古老的修复术来复原石像吗？

say:7:1041548307:1.text: ... You seem like an accomplished mage yourself. Could it be that you admire Magister Merlin too?
say:7:1041548307:1.source_cn: ……您看起来是位非常优秀的魔法师。您也是梅林大人的崇拜者吗？
say:7:1041548307:1.male: ... You seem like an accomplished mage yourself. Could it be that you admire Magister Merlin too?
say:7:1041548307:1.female: ... You seem like an accomplished mage yourself. Could it be that you admire Magister Merlin too?

say:9:1041548309:1.text: We were classmates once. Now, I serve as a court mage.
say:9:1041548309:1.source_cn: 我们曾是同窗，而现在，我是一名宫廷魔法师。

say:10:1041548310:1.text: W-what?! You were Magister Merlin's classmate? That means you graduated from the Serene Lyceum, doesn't it?!
say:10:1041548310:1.source_cn: ——什么，原来您是梅林大人的同窗？！您也是莱希拉姆的前辈！
say:10:1041548310:1.male: W-what?! You were Magister Merlin's classmate? That means you graduated from the Serene Lyceum, doesn't it?!
say:10:1041548310:1.female: W-what?! You were Magister Merlin's classmate? That means you graduated from the Serene Lyceum, doesn't it?!

say:11:1041548311:1.text: They say Magister Merlin refused an invitation to the Lightbearer Royal Court, uninterested in fame or fortune. Surely you know the real reason behind such a decision?
say:11:1041548311:1.source_cn: 传说不慕名利的梅林曾拒绝过耀光王室的邀请，您一定知道个...
say:11:1041548311:1.male: They say Magister Merlin refused an invitation to the Lightbearer Royal Court, uninterested in fame or fortune. Surely you know the real reason behind such a decision?
say:11:1041548311:1.female: They say Magister Merlin refused an invitation to the Lightbearer Royal Court, uninterested in fame or fortune. Surely you know the real reason behind such a decision?

say:12:1041548312:1.text: Uninterested in fame and fortune, you say? Then tell me, why does the world know the name Merlin so well?
say:12:1041548312:1.male: Uninterested in fame and fortune, you say? Then tell me, why does the world know the name Merlin so well?
say:12:1041548312:1.female: Uninterested in fame and fortune, you say? Then tell me, why does the world know the name Merlin so well?

say:13:1041548313:1.text: Well, isn't it obvious? Because he is the most powerful mage alive!
say:13:1041548313:1.male: Well, isn't it obvious? Because he is the most powerful mage alive!
say:13:1041548313:1.female: Well, isn't it obvious? Because she is the most powerful mage alive!

say:14:1041548314:1.text: Oh, I can't even imagine how amazing it must've been to study magic alongside him!
say:14:1041548314:1.source_cn: 我真羡慕您，能跟梅林大人同窗学习魔法一定很幸福吧！
say:14:1041548314:1.male: Oh, I can't even imagine how amazing it must've been to study magic alongside him!
say:14:1041548314:1.female: Oh, I can't even imagine how amazing it must've been to study magic alongside her!

say:16:1041548316:1.text: I see that smile! You must be thinking about those days with fondness. What a wonderful time it must have been.
say:16:1041548316:1.source_cn: 我知道了，您连回想起那段时光都会笑出声，想必求学的日子...

say:17:1041548317:1.text: Even you, a court mage, can't help but praise him. Just as all the books say—Magister Merlin truly is unparalleled!
say:17:1041548317:1.source_cn: 连同窗的宫廷魔法师也对梅林如此欣赏，<male>他</...
say:17:1041548317:1.male: Even you, a court mage, can't help but praise him. Just as all the books say—Magister Merlin truly is unparalleled!
say:17:1041548317:1.female: Even you, a court mage, can't help but praise her. Just as all the books say—Magister Merlin truly is unparalleled!

say:19:1041548319:1.text: Here's your book back, diligent one.
